kicker: BTL-3, from a thin model card

scenes.headline: How a small adapter turns Qwen into a tool-using agent
scenes.sub: BTL-3: a rank-32 LoRA, RL-tuned on top of Qwen3.6-27B.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Custard! BTL-3 isn't a new model. It's a small adapter that teaches Qwen3.6 to run an agent loop. Here's how.

scenes.text: The capability is Qwen's. A frozen rank-32 adapter, about 934 MB, adds the loop behaviour, including knowing when not to call a tool.
scenes.mark: when not to call a tool
scenes.say: The capability is Qwen's. A frozen adapter of about nine hundred thirty-four megabytes adds the behaviour, including knowing when not to call a tool.

scenes.title: How the adapter is made and used

items.text: Pin Qwen3.6-27B to an exact revision
items.say: Start from Qwen3.6, twenty-seven billion parameters, pinned to an exact revision. The base is never changed.

items.text: Train a rank-32 LoRA with RL
items.say: Train a rank thirty-two adapter with reinforcement learning, over long, multi-step trajectories.
Freeze the result. That's the release: the difference, not the model.

items.text: Load the base, apply the adapter
items.say: To run it, load the base and apply the adapter. Thinking mode is recommended for coding.

scenes.title: The loop it was tuned to run

steps.say: A request comes in, and the model reasons about it.
Then the route decision: does this need a tool at all? If not, it just answers. That's the hard part to train.
If it does, it calls one tool, or several at once, in parallel.
It inspects the result. If a call failed, it recovers and goes round again, until no action is required.

scenes.title: BFCL v4 by category, self-reported
scenes.note: every figure is Bad Theory Labs' own; no independent evaluation yet
scenes.say: By its own numbers, it declines correctly ninety-one point two percent of the time. Its soft spot is several calls, each with several arguments: seventy percent.

scenes.label: BTL-3 Compact: the whole text model in one native file
scenes.note: an effective under 2.5 bits per parameter
scenes.say: There's also a Compact build: the whole text model in one eight point three nine gigabyte file, under two and a half bits per parameter.

scenes.text: The intelligence is Qwen's, the discipline is BTL's: a trained instinct to not call a tool.
scenes.say: The intelligence is Qwen's. The discipline is the adapter's: a trained instinct not to call a tool when none is needed.

recap: A frozen rank-32 LoRA on Qwen3.6-27B
RL-tuned to reason, act, inspect and recover
And to stop when no tool is needed
scenes.say: To recap: a frozen adapter on Qwen, tuned to reason, act and recover, and to stop when no tool is needed.
